commands.export: structure export MDU (--all|--id FULL_ID repeat) --representation geometry|hydraulic-bundle --out NEW_DIRECTORY [--apply --expect-sha256 HASH]
commands.import: Representation-specific forms import_geometry/import_hydraulic below; no generic geometry --all/append admission
commands.import_geometry: structure import MDU --source GEOMETRY_DIRECTORY --representation geometry --id TARGET_ID --mode replace-matching --coordinates model-xy-as-is --xy-unit m [--apply --expect-sha256 HASH]
commands.import_hydraulic: structure import MDU --source HYDRAULIC_BUNDLE_DIRECTORY --representation hydraulic-bundle (--all|--id FULL_ID repeat) --mode append|replace-matching --coordinates model-xy-as-is --xy-unit m --target-structure-file EXISTING_RELATIVE_INI --asset-map MAP.json [--height-unit m --vertical-datum LABEL] [--apply --expect-sha256 HASH]

identity.selection: Export/hydraulic: actual native source INI Structure.id. Geometry import: one explicitly requested actual target INI ID plus operator-declared route_id; never PLI header identity.
identity.IDs: CLI policy canonical printable ASCII1..255 bytes; source IDLEN256 recommendation distinct from G18MATR64
identity.duplicates: global exact/casefold collisions refused as policy
identity.source_order: Export/hydraulic: native StructureFile list order then physical block order. Geometry import: one explicitly selected operator route; no claimed native source order.

representations.geometry: One exact active single-block XY PLI per unique source file plus untrusted operator-routing geometry.json; no source INI, hydraulic/forcing properties or verified source ID/type/authenticity. Never concatenate locations or match/relabel PLI headers.
representations.hydraulic-bundle: CLI-owned index + selected raw native INI cores/General + supported exact geometry/forcing assets + raw source-context MDU; context is not complete model closure, not an observed GUI format or runnable model

INI_framing.General: one explicit General before structures; version3.01/type structure; first known global context version+type only, no synthesized defaults
INI_framing.core: section header through LAST key/value record inclEOL; interior comments copied
INI_framing.file_owned: prologue and trailing comments/blanks between cores/footer
INI_framing.projection: General core plus selected raw cores; omitted file-owned trivia disclosed
INI_framing.replacement: destination General/gaps/footer/non-target blocks exact; source/destination semantic context match
INI_framing.bridges: explicit destination-first-EOL separator where required, record exact offsets/hex/hash

kinds: modern weir with scalar or root TIM crest
I1_eligibility.dimension: planar locationFile transport; require explicit Kmx0; actual mesh topology/2D-vs1D validity not inferred without decoding
I1_eligibility.format: one root3.01 StructureFile; MDU geometry/StructureFile value nonempty unquoted whitespace-free, explicit PathsRelativeToParent0, sole XY locationFile; same supported class on hydraulic replacement; NO whitespace/quote characters/semicolon in MDU StructureFile value
I1_eligibility.geometry_import: ONE explicit --id TARGET_ID/replace-matching to actual existing unshared PLI role; route_id operator-declared, source native ID/type unavailable; --all/append refused; no hydraulic defaults
I1_eligibility.hydraulic_import: one explicit existing declared INI only; append or replace-matching; no MDU or asset writes
I1_eligibility.assets: explicit unambiguous asset-map to existing byte-identical assets; actual role/clock consumers rebound; path token remaps only; no implicit copies, deletes or rewrites
I1_eligibility.unknowns: preserve all raw bytes; unknown selected/global keys or unresolved non-target edges block eligible transfer, never stripped

asset_map_proposal.rules: bounded JSON no duplicate/unknown keys, unique logical mappings, ordinary contained targets, actual hash/identity/role/clock check; no inferred name matching

spatial: Caller model-xy-as-is/m assertion; height m+explicit datum label when heights transferred. No CRS/axis/unit/vertical transformation or hidden mesh-snap. Actual datum metadata may remain unknown; sidecar assertions are not verified truth.
clock: TIM native minute column with actual RefDate/TZone; source/destination absolute origins/coverage must match. BC own CF origin/ordered typed quantity+unit columns; Name binds structure ID. No native initialized0 used as authored knot.

parameter_unit_conventions.qualification: Convention separate from actual declared header units; scalar/TIM has no invented Unit header

path_rules.spaces: I1 refuses whitespace ONLY in MDU geometry/StructureFile value. Child location/forcing and external bundle/output paths may contain spaces subject to their own readers/safety/native bounds. Modern semicolon filename-space capability is deferred, not full native qualification.
path_rules.native_bound: ENTIRE StructureFile string<=255 ASCII bytes before tokenization, each ID/parameter/fixed-buffer effective filename<=255 including applicable prefix; no truncation
path_rules.first_nesting: root file+mode0 only; nested/multi/mode1 deferred due exact duplicate-resolve and last-basedir code
path_rules.unsafe: no absolute/UNC/device/ADS/navigation/reparse/hardlinks/input-output aliases; external source/out outside model, existing ordinary parent, absent output
path_rules.counterpath: Model2414-2425 no-semicolon branch calls strsplit then prop_file on tokens; string_module787-848 defaults to whitespace with quote handling. Modern Readstructures90-103 alone cannot qualify a single with-spaces.ini MDU reference. No native failure claimed, no delimiter/quote bypass.
path_rules.child_and_external_spaces: Not globally prohibited: ordinary child location/forcing and external bundle/output paths may contain spaces subject to their own role-specific reader and all existing bounds/safety checks

scalar_discriminant: exact whole finite normal scalar or zero vs unambiguous supported filename; refuse numeric-prefix filename ambiguity; REALTIME blocked as controller dependency
sharing: read-only byte-identical assets may be shared only with all consumer edges bound; writable geometry/ID consumers must be exclusive or explicitly supported. Compound/controller/cross-profile effects cannot be ignored.
metadata: All indices untrusted and strictly parsed, actual paths/assets/hashes re-read. Native SOURCE ID/type re-derived from INI only for hydraulic-bundle; geometry-only source ID/type absent, route_id is explicit operator routing. Actual TARGET ID/type/roles always from INI; actual PLI geometry independent of label. Applicable native quantity/clock graph re-derived. No stored eligibility/passed/authenticity receipt authority, extraction/escape or unlisted dependency bypass. No runtime source-file hashing.
Pillar_namespace: Pillar labels/arrays are not proven Structure.id aliases; actual Structure ID namespace checked, unsupported Pillar interactions deferred/refused separately
location_separator_policy: Modern XY reader directly reads numeric XY, without G18 missing-X behavior. Nonnumeric separators refused; finite -999/999.999 coordinates not automatically treated as native separators.

publication.consent: input_sha256 over stable policy/request/raw selectors+order/assertions/map/graph+bundle identity bytes/security/absence/complete intended bytes+operation digests
publication.noop: identical complete import target ->fullrecheck/no staging/inode+mtime churn; export never overwrites
publication.I1: reviewed one-existing-file ACL publisher with real snapshot/access/lategraph callback; raw commit/rollback/cleanup honest
publication.export: reviewed fresh-dir ownership adapter, exclusive commit, parent/security lateguards; retain final postcommit failures
publication.I7: separate new-asset/multi-file commit/recovery protocol; sequence of per-file atomic replaces is not global atomicity

supersedes.delta: Two admission clarifications in ADDENDUM.md; parent evidence unchanged

geometry_routing_proposal.schema: Only format/routes and route_id/asset_path; strict bounded types, no duplicate JSON keys, unique exact/casefold-safe routes, one source asset per selected route, paths and listed assets verified; no source_type/verified_id/passed authority
geometry_routing_proposal.geometry_import_request: Exactly one --id TARGET_ID and mode replace-matching; --all/append refused in I1 geometry import. Selected route_id must exactly equal explicit target request.
geometry_routing_proposal.actual_native_identity: Target ID/type/location-file role and consumers re-derived from actual destination INI. Hydraulic source identity absent and unverified in geometry mode.
geometry_routing_proposal.payload_geometry: Actual source PLI label/count/ordered XY parsed independently of route_id; label never matched or rewritten to imply Structure.id.
geometry_routing_proposal.consent: All request/map/path/asset bytes, identities, raw geometry and target graph bound; altered routing requires new preview; no automatic target selection from metadata.
